{{Current events|year=2019|month=01|day=21|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Maidan Shar attack]]
**A [[Taliban]] attack on a [[National Directorate of Security]] compound in the central [[Maidan Wardak Province]], kills 126 security personnel, according to local officials. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/21/taliban-kill-more-than-100-in-attack-on-afghan-military-base (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Dissident Irish Republican campaign]]
**In two incidents in [[Derry]], a truck is [[carjacking|hijacked]] and abandoned in the city center, and a [[Royal Mail]] van is hijacked at gunpoint and later abandoned. Authorities blame the [[New IRA]]. [https://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/northern-ireland/derry-police-at-two-security-alerts-royal-mail-van-stolen-and-abandoned-37732335.html (''Belfast Telegraph'')]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**A suicide [[car bomb]] attack kills five members of the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] while they were out on a patrol with U.S. troops in northeastern Syria. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/01/21/suicide-car-bomb-northern-syria-leaves-five-sdf-forces-dead/ (''Telegraph'')]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] says it had [[Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War|attacked Iranian military]] targets in [[Damascus]] including the [[Damascus International Airport|city's international airport]] in response to a missile attack. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/21/middleeast/israel-strikes-iran-targets-syria-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**A [[mutiny]] by members of the [[Venezuelan National Guard]] who oppose the government is quashed. The [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|Venezuelan Military]] in a statement says they were involved in "treasonous" acts motivated by "obscure interests tied to the far right." [http://time.com/5508686/venezuela-mutiny-national-guard-unit/ (''Time'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Germany]] revokes the license of [[Iran]]ian airline [[Mahan Air]], citing the airline's involvement in [[Syria]] and other security concerns. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-iran-airline/germany-bans-iranian-airline-on-suspicion-of-spying-terror-idUSKCN1PF0QC? (Reuters)]
*The [[Israel Airports Authority]] formally opens [[Ramon Airport]] in the [[Timna Valley]] near [[Eilat]]. The new international airport replaces [[Eilat Airport]], which will cease operations on January 22. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/israel-opens-new-international-airport-near-red-sea-11149264 (Channel NewsAsia)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu disappearance]]
**A [[Piper Malibu]] light aircraft, carrying two people on a flight from [[Nantes]] to [[Cardiff]], goes missing off the coast of [[Alderney]] in the [[Channel Islands]]. A major search and rescue operation is underway. [[Cardiff City F.C.]] footballer [[Emiliano Sala]] is confirmed to have been on board the missing aircraft. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-guernsey-46954922 (BBC News)], [https://news.sky.com/story/cardiff-city-investigate-reports-footballer-emiliano-sala-was-on-missing-plane-11614303 (Sky)]
*At least 11 crew members are killed after two ships caught fire, as one vessel was transferring fuel to the other, in the [[Kerch Strait]] near [[Crimea]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2019/01/2-ships-on-fire-in-the-kerch-strait-near-crimea/ (BNO)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46948718 (BBC News)]
*Two men are killed in separate avalanches at U.S. ski resorts, one near [[Aspen, Colorado]], and another in Kachina Peak at Taos Ski Valley, approximately {{convert|125|miles|km}} northeast of [[Albuquerque, New Mexico]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/two-deaths-confirmed-separate-avalanches-colorado-new-mexico-n961076 (NBC News)] 

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in Egypt]]
**[[Television in Egypt|Egyptian TV]] presenter Mohamed al-Ghiety is sentenced to one year of hard labor and fined 3,000 Egyptian pounds ($167; £130) for "promoting homosexuality" by interviewing a [[Human male sexuality#Male homosexuality|gay man]] on the privately-owned LTC Egypt TV channel last year. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46946612 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Kamala Harris]] from [[California]] announces [[Kamala Harris 2020 presidential campaign|she will run]] for [[President of the United States|President]] in 2020. [https://www.npr.org/2019/01/21/677834764/sen-kamala-harris-announces-2020-presidential-candidacy (NPR)]
**[[Howard Schultz]], former CEO of [[Starbucks]], is reported to be exploring an independent candidacy for President of the United States in 2020. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/21/politics/howard-schultz-starbucks-2020/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Labour Party of the United Kingdom|Labour Party]] proposes an amendment to the Brexit deal which would require a second referendum before the [[United Kingdom]] fully exits the [[European Union]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/jan/21/labour-calls-for-vote-in-commons-on-holding-second-referendum (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Lulu and Nana controversy]]
**[[China]] confirms the 2018 birth of the world's first genetically edited babies, Lulu and Nana, saying [[He Jiankui]] forged ethical review papers and organised a project team with foreign staff, which intentionally avoided surveillance, and that He and his staff will be punished according to laws and regulations. The [[Government of Guangdong|Guangdong government]] will keep the twins under medical observation with the support of the national departments. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/science/article/2182964/china-confirms-gene-edited-babies-blames-scientist-he-jiankui (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[January 2019 lunar eclipse]]
**A total [[lunar eclipse]] occurs, popularly dubbed a Super Blood Wolf Moon, due to the timing and orbital perigee, and a meteor impact is observed during the event. [https://www.space.com/43075-blood-moon-2019-meteor-impact-video.html (Space.com)]
